candidate.answerReason: Pairing eight factors of 2 with eight factors of 5 gives N=16·10^8, which has the two digits of 16 followed by eight zeros.

methods.label: Pair factors to make powers of ten
methods.explanation:
Each pair of factors \(2\) and \(5\) makes \(10\). There are eight such pairs, leaving four factors of \(2\), so
\[
\begin{aligned}
N&=2^4\cdot2^8\cdot5^8\\
 &=16\cdot(2\cdot5)^8\\
 &=16\cdot10^8.
\end{aligned}
\]
Multiplying \(16\) by \(10^8\) appends eight zeros. Thus \(N\) has \(2+8=\boxed{10}\) digits, choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
methods.levelReason: The solution uses elementary power laws and decimal place value, without logarithms.
